title: C3 · Attestation response (C -> B)
description: Response body of POST /v1/attestations. HTTP 200 for accepted/pending, 422 for rejected, 409 when the epoch was already minted (status rejected, reason_code epoch_already_minted). The miner treats any 4xx as final and any 5xx/network error as 'retry later'.

status.description: accepted = mint transaction confirmed; pending = verified and mint transaction sent but not yet confirmed; rejected = will never mint.

amount.description: Amount minted (base units). Equals the claimed amount when accepted.

reason.description: Human-readable reason, shown on the admin portal and in the twin's anti-cheat log.
